//: Canonical Claude plugin manifest. The M9 build / M10 installer deploys this to .claude-plugin/plugin.json at the plugin root (that path is environment-protected here, so it is generated at package/install time). To test locally, copy this file to .claude-plugin/plugin.json then run: claude --plugin-dir .
name: reader-first-writing
description: A reader-first writing system: structure, draft, diagnose, revise, and review documents across argument architecture and sentence-level prose, with fidelity-preserving revision and independent review. Routes by writing goal (plan, compose, diagnose, restructure, revise, adapt, compare, review, finalize, teach).
